dog.description_text:
Meet Rhylee!

We’re so excited to welcome Rhylee into foster care with Every Last One Rescue. This girl is a whole lot of joy in one petite pup, and everyone she meets is instantly a friend.

Rhylee is approximately three years old, is ALWAYS happy, walks nicely on leash, is potty trained, and was a total volunteer favorite at the shelter. She’s been collecting fans everywhere she goes. She responds to her name, knows “sit,” goes into her crate so easily, and snoozes once inside. She adores everyone she meets and is such a cuddle bug. Rhylee seems to like other dogs and loves people.

Rhylee is an energetic girl and would do best with some time to run around, play, and engage in enrichment. She does great in an apartment setting with a nice long walk to get her day started:)

Rhylee has been at the shelter for over four months waiting to be seen. Now she’s getting her chance to settle into foster care, and we can’t wait to keep learning more about her!
dog.name: Rhylee
